method: Verified the workbook URL for each of 14 jurisdictions with WebFetch (2-4 fetches each, plus WebSearch to locate replacement/list pages); pages that 403'd were retried through src/scrapfly_browser.py (residential JS render), which succeeded on Stafford and Fairfax City before the Scrapfly account was rate-limited, after which blocked pages were recorded as blocked and workbook values kept. Downloaded PDFs (Frederick, Anne Arundel, Carroll) were inspected with pypdfium2. Read-only: no accounts, forms, CAPTCHAs or Firecrawl.
